Description: Users or services have more permissions than needed
Mitigation Strategy: Use predefined roles; enforce least privilege; review monthly
Remove admin roles; use workload identity federation
Enforce MFA for all privileged users

Description: Permissions accumulate over time without review

Mitigation Strategy: Use private subnets; restrict external IPs

Description: Open firewall rules allow global access
Mitigation Strategy: Restrict to specific IP ranges; use Cloud Armor

Description: Services communicate over public internet instead of private channels

Mitigation Strategy: Disable public access; use uniform bucket-level access

Description: Data loss possible due to missing versioning
Mitigation Strategy: Enable object versioning; set lifecycle rules
Enable Admin, Data Access, and System logs
Create alert policies in Cloud Monitoring
Export logs to BigQuery or SIEM pipeline

Description: Instances run with overly permissive default accounts
Mitigation Strategy: Use custom service accounts with least privilege
